summary: StageRunState.attempts is untyped rather than the required AttemptRecord array.
evidence: src/types.ts:261-265 declares attempts: any despite the approved slice explicitly requiring an attempts array on StageRunState. The comment documents an intentional bypass for the existing numeric runner counter; this removes compiler/IDE enforcement and lets subsequent attempt-memory code store either an invalid shape or a number without detection.
suggestedRemediation: Declare attempts as AttemptRecord[] and introduce a separately named, strongly typed legacy attempt counter (or a defined migration-compatible union plus narrowing) if the current runner still needs numeric behavior.
